patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring a massive typographic element as a background visual, with foreground text and interactive elements positioned off-center.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif typography is used as a primary visual element, often spanning the full width of the viewport and acting as a background or anchor for sections.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is used for UI elements and text, with vibrant, full-bleed project imagery providing the main bursts of color.
The oversized 'LETTER' hero text and associated floating graphic elements parallax slowly as the user scrolls, creating a layered depth effect while foreground content scrolls over them.
Project showcases are presented as full-bleed image sections, each introduced by a large, distinct typographic title that often uses a unique font or styling.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a layered parallax effect where a massive background text element and smaller graphic cards scroll at a slower rate than the main content, creating a sense of depth. The main navigation and a cookie consent banner remain sticky at the top and bottom-right respectively.
Project sections are introduced with full-bleed imagery and large, custom-styled typographic titles, creating distinct visual breaks and emphasizing each project.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized display headings (e.g., 'LETTER', project titles) are dramatically larger (~8-10x) than the small, legible body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy and acting as graphic elements.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all UI elements, images, and section boundaries, contributing to a clean, modern, and bold aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: A balanced to airy density, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample negative space around hero elements and large titles, contrasting with a tighter grid for project listings on interior pages.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its audacious use of typography as a primary visual and structural element, particularly the massive, parallaxing 'LETTER' text in the hero that acts as a persistent brand anchor, making the brand name itself an integral part of the design experience.
